display.label: Container Registry
display.description: Azure Container Registry for managing private Docker container images and related artifacts

resource.key_description: The unique name for the Azure Container Registry. Serves as the map key.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Core Container Registry identification, resource group, location, and SKU tier.

fields.label: Registry Name
fields.description: Globally unique name for the Container Registry. Must be between 5 and 50 alphanumeric characters (letters and numbers only).

validation.pattern_error: Container Registry name must be between 5 and 50 alphanumeric characters without hyphens or special symbols.

fields.label: Resource Group Name
fields.description: The name of the Resource Group in which to create the Container Registry. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: The Azure Region where the Container Registry should be created. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

fields.label: SKU Tier
fields.description: The SKU tier of the Container Registry. Choose between Basic, Standard, and Premium.

options.label: Standard (General purpose with higher storage and throughput)
Premium (Enterprise features: Geo-replication, Customer-Managed Keys, Private Endpoints, Content Trust)

fields.label: Admin User Enabled
fields.description: Specifies whether the admin user credentials (username and passwords) are enabled for basic docker authentication.

sections.label: Networking & Security
sections.description: Public access, network bypass options, managed identity, and firewall rules.

fields.label: Public Network Access Enabled
fields.description: Whether public network access is allowed for the container registry.

fields.label: Network Rule Bypass Option
fields.description: Whether to allow trusted Azure services to access a network-restricted container registry.

fields.label: Managed Identity
fields.description: Managed service identity configuration for the container registry.

fields.label: Identity Type
fields.description: The type of Managed Service Identity for the container registry.

fields.label: User Assigned Identity IDs
fields.description: List of User Assigned Managed Identity IDs to assign. Required when type is UserAssigned or SystemAssigned, UserAssigned.

fields.label: Network Rule Set
fields.description: Network rule set configuration to restrict registry access by IP addresses or virtual networks (only available with Premium SKU).

fields.label: Default Action
fields.description: The default action when no rule matches: Allow or Deny.

fields.label: IP Firewall Rules
fields.description: List of IP rules to allow access from specific CIDR IP ranges.

fields.label: Action
fields.description: The action to apply for this IP range.

fields.label: IP Range (CIDR)
fields.description: The CIDR to grant access to (e.g. 104.45.231.0/24).

sections.label: Policies & Premium Features
sections.description: Zone redundancy, geo-replication, retention, and content trust policies.

fields.label: Zone Redundancy Enabled
fields.description: Whether zone redundancy is enabled for this container registry (only available with Premium SKU).

fields.label: Anonymous Pull Enabled
fields.description: Whether anonymous (unauthenticated) pull access is enabled (only available with Standard or Premium SKU).

fields.label: Data Endpoint Enabled
fields.description: Whether to enable dedicated data endpoints for this container registry (only available with Premium SKU).

fields.label: Export Policy Enabled
fields.description: Boolean value that indicates whether export policy is enabled (only available with Premium SKU).

fields.label: Quarantine Policy Enabled
fields.description: Boolean value that indicates whether quarantine policy is enabled.

fields.label: Retention Policy (Days)
fields.description: The number of days to retain untagged manifests before deletion. Set to null to disable (only available with Premium SKU).

fields.label: Content Trust Policy Enabled
fields.description: Boolean value that indicates whether Docker Content Trust (DCT) image signing is enabled (only available with Premium SKU).

fields.label: Geo-Replications
fields.description: List of geo-replications for the container registry across different Azure regions (only available with Premium SKU).

fields.label: Replication Region
fields.description: The Azure location where the container registry should be geo-replicated.

fields.label: Regional Endpoint Enabled
fields.description: Whether to enable a dedicated regional data endpoint for this replication.

fields.label: Zone Redundancy Enabled
fields.description: Whether zone redundancy is enabled for this geo-replication.

fields.label: Replication Tags
fields.description: A mapping of tags to assign to this replication.

sections.label: Tags
sections.description: Resource tags for organization, governance, and billing.

fields.label: Tags
fields.description: Key-value pairs to tag the Container Registry for organization, governance, and billing.
